limitations.note: The rewrite prevents green from lighting during red, but it also lights red immediately on reset and replaces the original registered transition timing, both of which the reference fix preserves.
The replacement keeps the ports but removes the four public state parameters, so existing instantiations that override them would no longer compile.
The test requires the rewrite’s immediate-red reset and new countdown timing, so it passes the rewrite but would reject the one-line fix that preserves the original behavior.
